intro: I'm currently learning Roblox game development — Luau scripting, client/server architecture, DataStores and publishing a live experience.
Rather than following tutorials, I learn by shipping: each game is designed, built and published by me, and both are live and free to play on Roblox.
learnings: Porting a Unity prototype to Roblox and rethinking it for a shared, server-authoritative multiplayer world
Structuring a Luau codebase with Rojo, so the game lives in Git and is edited in VS Code instead of Studio
Persisting player data and leaderboards with DataStores while staying inside Roblox's request budgets
Designing a long-term progression economy, then verifying every number with scripts before it ships
Localization, monetization (Developer Products), badges and the full publishing flow on the Creator Dashboard

games.title: Spinning Slayers
desc: The second game in the series, and a different kind of game: instead of a run that resets, every coin you earn upgrades your spinning weapon permanently. Clear room after room, beat the boss, and unlock the next world — and once all six are conquered, Rebirth to start over stronger than before.
About 60% of the code was carried over from Spinning Survivors — the rest went into a full progression economy, whose constants are documented in one place and checked by scripts on every change.
features: Orbiting blades auto-attack — you just dodge and move
6 worlds, each with a boss that enrages if you're slow
Permanent upgrades, 4 skills and rare blade skins
Rebirth for permanent power, plus an Endless mode
Gold mines and leaderboards in a shared hub

games.title: Spinning Survivors
games.tagline: Survive the horde. Become the storm.
desc: My first Roblox game — a Vampire-Survivors-like roguelike. Enemies pour in from every direction while your skills fire automatically; every kill drops EXP, and every level-up lets you pick a new skill or upgrade.

It started as a Unity prototype I had built earlier. Porting it meant redesigning the parts Roblox does differently: there is no global time scale on a shared server, so pause and game speed run per player on the server.
features: 5 auto-firing skills — Shuriken, Fireball, Ice Cone, Lightning and orbiting Blades
Endless waves with scaling tiers, mini-bosses and bosses
Play solo or team up with friends in a shared run
Global Top-20 leaderboard and unlockable weapon skins
